exposure: All159 unused by the entity-gating study, but previously evaluated by earlier project retrieval benchmarks. Not a pristine holdout or new corpus. Same selection predicate and seven conversations as development cohort.
primary_contrast: body-only BM25 on name-stripped query plus original-query adjacency activation: gated authored-by/mentions candidates versus ungated all records. Candidate-local normalization is part of the gating treatment.
criterion: Mean paired original-gold evidence recall@16 gated-minus-ungated >=0.02. Also require paired conversation-cluster bootstrap95 lower bound >0, as in original retrieval criterion. Report threshold and uncertainty checks separately.

bootstrap.estimator: pooled question mean after sampling seven conversations with replacement

secondary: Complete-evidence packets, per-question wins/ties/losses and per-conversation deltas; no additional decision criteria.
policy: One execution on frozen membership and settings, no tuning/retries or model calls. Report outcomes either way; keep adjacency default and experimental entity import. Stop after reporting.
